correctness.rationale: Triangular matrix-unit representation gives eigenvalues including algebraic multiplicities. Unique earliest coherence slope (gamma1/2+2gammaphi) has 2n vacuum-one-excitation modes; population j-gamma1 has binomial multiplicity. Before the first slope-diverse mode the spectrum map has Jacobian rank at most one, afterward the gradients (1,0) and (1/2,2) have determinant 2; off-tie cells are affine so rank two guarantees local injectivity. Remaining claims follow by binomial counting and standard CLT. Exact-rational checks and independently assembled small-n full Liouvillians corroborate; no finite check is relied on for the universal proof.

value.rationale: The sharp budget gives the first decay-spectrum coordinate that identifies two physically distinct dissipative rates; the whole generic ratio phase diagram specifies observation depth where only extreme regimes were understood. The fixed-box phase change at n=21 (exponential to polynomial asymptotics) and Gaussian transition for n-dependent rates explain concrete experimental/scalability boundaries. The result has structural and design content beyond merely reindexing eigenvalues, while making no claim about noise-robust learning.
